# FDG8089

> DO implement the `ISerializable` members explicitly.

Framework Design Guidelines, 3rd edition, section 8.10 Serialization.

## How it is checked

- Check: fdg (partial coverage)
- Diagnostics: FDG8089
- Automatic fix: not applied automatically (the fix can break callers)
- Severity: library warning, application warning, test warning
- Status: verified

Message: Implement ISerializable.GetObjectData explicitly in '{0}'

FDG8089 reports a method that implements ISerializable.GetObjectData implicitly, that is a GetObjectData method that is neither an explicit implementation nor an override. Overrides, such as the GetObjectData of a class derived from Exception, are not reported, since the base class made the member public; so coverage is partial. Making the method an explicit implementation removes a public method, so the fix is breaking; there is no code fix.

## From the book

```csharp
[Serializable]
public class Person : ISerializable {
  void ISerializable.GetObjectData(...) {
    ...
  }
}
```
